name: critic-P09 b1 — THE CAMERA, fresh eyes, no charity: does it ever zoom, jerk, fight, clip, dither or lose the boy?

steps.note: MEASURING RIG — per-frame camera samples, where the boy sits on screen, and whether anything is between the lens and him

steps.eval: (async () => { const THREE = await import('three'); const { Field } = await import('/src/world/field.js'); const W = () => Field.world(); const rig = { THREE, Field, probe(ms) { return new Promise(res => { const S = []; const t0 = performance.now(); const v = new THREE.Vector3(); const step = () => { const w = W(); if (w && w.camera && w.player) { const c = w.camera, p = w.player.p; v.set(p.x, p.y + 1.0, p.z); v.project(c); const st = (__DQ.state().field || {}).camera || {}; S.push({ t: +(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(1), cx: +c.position.x.toFixed(4), cy: +c.position.y.toFixed(4), cz: +c.position.z.toFixed(4), sx: +v.x.toFixed(4), sy: +v.y.toFixed(4), fov: +c.fov.toFixed(3), px: +p.x.toFixed(3), py: +p.y.toFixed(3), pz: +p.z.toFixed(3), occ: st.occluding || 0, dist: st.dist, ground: (w.map && w.map.height) ? +w.map.height(c.position.x, c.position.z).toFixed(3) : null }); } if (performance.now() - t0 < ms) requestAnimationFrame(step); else res(rig.stats(S)); }; requestAnimationFrame(step); }); }, start(ms) { window.__critLast = 'running'; rig.probe(ms).then(r => { window.__critLast = r; }); return 'probing ' + ms + 'ms'; }, stats(S) { const n = S.length; if (n < 4) return { frames: n, error: 'too few frames' }; const sp = [], ac = []; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { const dt = Math.max(1, S[i].t - S[i - 1].t) / 1000; sp.push(Math.hypot(S[i].cx - S[i - 1].cx, S[i].cy - S[i - 1].cy, S[i].cz - S[i - 1].cz) / dt); } for (let i = 1; i < sp.length; i++) ac.push((sp[i] - sp[i - 1]) / 0.0167); let maxJerk = 0; for (let i = 1; i < ac.length; i++) maxJerk = Math.max(maxJerk, Math.abs(ac[i] - ac[i - 1])); const rng = a => [+Math.min.apply(null, a).toFixed(3), +Math.max.apply(null, a).toFixed(3)]; const dh = S.map(s => (s.ground == null ? 99 : +(s.cy - s.ground).toFixed(3))); const heroRadius = S.map(s => +Math.hypot(s.cx - s.px, s.cz - s.pz).toFixed(3)); return { frames: n, seconds: +(S[n - 1].t / 1000).toFixed(2), camSpeedMax: +Math.max.apply(null, sp).toFixed(2), camAccelMax: +Math.max.apply(null, ac.map(Math.abs)).toFixed(1), camJerkMax: +maxJerk.toFixed(1), heroScreenX: rng(S.map(s => s.sx)), heroScreenY: rng(S.map(s => s.sy)), heroOffscreenFrames: S.filter(s => Math.abs(s.sx) > 1 || Math.abs(s.sy) > 1).length, fovRange: rng(S.map(s => s.fov)), camDistRange: rng(S.map(s => s.dist == null ? 0 : s.dist)), camGroundClearanceMin: +Math.min.apply(null, dh).toFixed(3), camRadiusFromHero: rng(heroRadius), framesWithOccluder: S.filter(s => s.occ > 0).length, heroMoved: +Math.hypot(S[n - 1].px - S[0].px, S[n - 1].pz - S[0].pz).toFixed(2), pathBend: (() => { const a = S[0], b = S[n - 1]; const dx = b.px - a.px, dz = b.pz - a.pz, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; let m = 0; for (const q of S) m = Math.max(m, Math.abs((q.px - a.px) * dz - (q.pz - a.pz) * dx) / L); return +m.toFixed(3); })() }; } }; window.__crit = rig; return 'rig installed'; })()

steps.note: A. THE OPENING FRAME — untouched. Is this inviting? Does it tell a ten-year-old where to go?
B. WALKING UP THE LANE with the real arrow key — 12 frames of motion plus a per-frame measurement
C. DOES IT FIGHT THE PLAYER? Hold up-and-right together for two and a half seconds and watch whether his path bends while the camera swings
D. RUNNING along the path (Shift held) — a different speed, so the spring has to keep up
E. STOP AND WAIT. Four seconds of no input at all: does it settle, drift, or snap?
F. THE COTTAGE. Stand in front of it, then orbit the whole way round in eight steps — does the lens go through the thatch, into the ground, or lose him?

steps.eval: (async () => { const out = []; for (const a of [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315]) { __DQ.cameraOrbit(a); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1100)); const c = __DQ.state().field.camera; const w = window.__crit.Field.world(); const g = w.map && w.map.height ? w.map.height(c.pos[0], c.pos[2]) : null; out.push({ orbit: a, dist: c.dist, distTarget: c.distTarget, occluding: c.occluding, clearance: g == null ? null : +(c.pos[1] - g).toFixed(2), fading: (__DQ.cameraOccluders() || []).length }); } window.__critOrbit = out; return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps.msg: the camera never pulls in to dodge the cottage
the lens never sinks into the ground on a full orbit

steps.note: G. WALKING THROUGH the cottage's shadow with the camera following — natural occlusion, 12 frames
H. THE TREES. Find the fattest canopy on the map, stand the boy under it with the lens outside it, and look.

steps.eval: (async () => { const w = window.__crit.Field.world(); const rigf = w.cameraRig.fade; const cam = __DQ.state().field.camera; const p = w.player.p; const flat = Math.cos(cam.pitch * Math.PI / 180) * cam.dist, up = Math.sin(cam.pitch * Math.PI / 180) * cam.dist + 0.5; const list = (rigf.objects(900) || []).filter(o => o.r > 1.4); let best = null; for (const o of list) { const h = Math.max(0.6, o.y - p.y); let back = flat * (h - 0.85) / Math.max(0.5, up - 0.85); back = Math.max(0.9, Math.min(flat - 1.4, back)); const gap = Math.hypot(flat - back, up - h) - o.r; if (gap > 1.2 && (!best || o.r > best.o.r)) best = { o, back, gap }; } if (!best) return 'no canopy fits the lens'; __DQ.cameraAuto(false); __DQ.teleport('meadow', +best.o.x.toFixed(2), +(best.o.z - best.back).toFixed(2), 0); __DQ.cameraOrbit(0); return JSON.stringify({ under: best.o.name || best.o.kind, r: +best.o.r.toFixed(2), back: +best.back.toFixed(2) }); })()

steps.note: the same frame with the fade switched off — if THIS is what the game normally shows, it is dithered
I. CLOSE-UP of whatever the fade does to a trunk — zoomed in hard so a checkerboard cannot hide
J. THE FOOTBRIDGE AND THE BECK — walk it; water and a narrow deck are where cameras clip

steps.eval: (async () => { const s = (__DQ.state().map && __DQ.state().map.probe) ? __DQ.state().map.probe() : null; return JSON.stringify(s || Object.keys(__DQ.state().map || {})); })()

steps.note: K. ORBIT WITH REAL KEYS (Q then E) — eased, or does it snap and slide?
L. THE VILLAGE CLUSTER in the north — three cottages together, the real test of framing and occlusion
M. TALKING — does the camera give a conversation a beat?
N. A BUILDING INTERIOR if there is one to go in — otherwise the interior framing on its own
O. THE MAP EDGE — push north until something stops him; is the camera still behaving out there?
P. LAST LOOK: back to the opening, and the health numbers

steps.msg: no runtime errors while a critic drove the camera
fps >= 50 through the whole camera audit
